Name: Father Time - Single Player time behavior in Co-Op
Author: EHoop30
Description:
[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Pauses time while a player is in a menu[/b]: inventory, chest, shop, dialogue, and so on, exactly like single-player. Pick whether the clock stops when [b]any[/b] player is busy (default) or only when [b]all[/b] of them are.[/*]
[*][b]Optional fishing pause[/b] (off by default, since the game never pauses for fishing even in single-player).[/*]
[*][b]Restores the Skull Cavern slowdown[/b] to co-op, even when only one player is down there while the others are elsewhere.[/*]
[/list]The clock only ever pauses. Everyone can still walk, fight, fish, and use tools; only the passage of time stops.

[size=4][b]In-game settings[/b][/size]
Press [b]F10[/b] (changeable in config.json) for a built-in settings menu. There is no dependency on any config-menu mod.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Multiplayer install[/b][/size]
The Skull Cavern slowdown needs only the host. Menu pause needs the mod on each player who wants their own menus to count. Installing it on everyone is the simplest option.
[b]Father Time[/b] fixes how time behaves in online co-op and adds host-controlled time tools.

Stardew's multiplayer never pauses the clock for menus and disables the Skull Cavern's slower time. Father Time restores both and adds more control on top.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Pauses time while a player is in a menu[/b] (inventory, chest, shop, dialogue), just like single-player. Pause when [b]any[/b] player is busy or only when [b]all[/b] are.[/*]
[*][b]Optional fishing pause[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Skull Cavern slowdown[/b] restored to co-op, even when only one player is down there.[/*]
[*][b]Global time slowdown[/b]: an optional 1.5x to 5x multiplier that slows the clock everywhere.[/*]
[*][b]Freeze / slow hotkeys[/b] for the host.[/*]
[*][b]Vote to pause[/b]: guests can vote to pause, with a notification shown to everyone.[/*]
[*][b]Configurable monster behavior[/b] during a pause (freeze like single-player, or keep moving).[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Host-controlled[/b][/size]
All settings are controlled by the host. Press [b]F10[/b] in-game: the host gets the full settings menu; guests get a small panel with just their vote control. No config-menu mod required.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[/list]Install on the host, plus any guest who wants their own menus, fishing, or votes to count.
